global: Let the bards sing of {fief}: its gates were breached and its standard torn down by the sons of {my_faction}.
The keys of {fief} now hang in our hall. Let {enemy_faction} come and collect them if they have the courage.
Weary as I am, my heart is light. {fief} is ours, and every soul who bled for it has earned a seat at our table.
{enemy_faction} left their larder half full and their pride entirely empty, which I find a fitting trade.
A toast, friends, to the ancestors who watched from the hills above {fief} and nodded at our victory.
Let {enemy_faction} remember this night: the banner of {my_faction} now flies where theirs once boasted of their strength.
Bread, wine and a roof at {fief} for any traveller who seeks shelter. The feuding is ended, and the hearth is warm.
Conquest is cheap, friends. Keeping {fief} against those who come for it is the true test of honour.
